run_lint: run pre-commit lint checks on the entire pybind11 codebase
run_tests: run the pybind11 test suite using cmake with catch and eigen downloaded
run_packaging_tests: run pytest on the extra_python_package packaging tests directory
build_docs: build the pybind11 documentation with sphinx in nitpicky mode
build_sdist_wheel: build an SDist and wheel for the pybind11 package
